m2-green.imperative: Create src/physics/segment_map/derivation/tiling.py: tile_reference_lap(ref: ReferenceLap) -> tiling result with boundaries_m (float64, strictly increasing, [0]==0.0, [-1]==ref.lap_length_m) and seg_type_code (int8, values in SegType {STRAIGHT=0, BRAKING_ZONE=1, CORNER=2}). Corner gate: abs(ref.curvature) > CORNER_CURVATURE_THRESHOLD. Braking zone: for each corner run (contiguous corner grid points, grouped on the LINEAR non-wrapping index space), search backward from the corner's start index down to the end of the previous corner run (or index 0 for the first corner -- no wrap into the tail) for the most-upstream (smallest index) grid point where ref.brake_active_frac first reaches BRAKING_ONSET_QUANTILE; if none found, no braking-zone segment for that corner. Straight = everything else. Group contiguous same-type grid points into segments with boundaries at the midpoint distance between adjacent differently-typed grid stations; boundaries_m[0]=0.0, boundaries_m[-1]=ref.lap_length_m. Run tests/unit/physics/segment_map/derivation/test_tiling.py on the pinned interpreter until green.
